assimilation_semantics.source_success: Broadcast only prior-layer workers with all Core tests passed and no infrastructure failure.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Broadcast no experience; never fall back to partial or failed trajectories.

pilot_gate.treatment_activation: At least one source_success layer-1 worker must reach full Core and layer 2 must report received_results greater than zero.
pilot_gate.directional_signal: Compare layer-2 mean Core score and full-Core workers against no_transfer.
pilot_gate.expand: Add layer 3 and two more replicates only if treatment activates and the layer-2 difference is non-zero.
pilot_gate.stop: Stop if treatment does not activate, if benchmark isolation is violated, or if infrastructure/gateway errors occur.

interpretation: Two-layer go/no-go pilot for strict verified-success experience transfer on a realistic transactional database-migration task.
